## What lands

- **Tile properties v2** (`exports/tiles.py`): the full `sig.map-tiles/2` §3.3 emit — sites carry `rk lb tc vd op oe sr j f l st tr pm co`; cells carry `h3 n ns jp s1 sx` plus `t_<code>`/`v_<slot>` facet counts. Per-(record, source) slices sharing a published point merge into one drawn feature (a record is drawn once — `rk` links one page); different honest positions stay separate. `st`: contested > provisional > corroborated (≥ 2 registry sources — the UXR-14 interim until L3 CONF-07b; legend "2+ source records; republications not yet collapsed") > single-source.
- **`web/map/dict.json`** (`sig.map-dict/1`, CC-BY-4.0, new `exports/map_dict.py`): source index, technology codes (active ontology slugs, `technology.yaml` order, 0 = unclassified), vendor slots (top-8 + other + unknown), jurisdiction chains + bboxes for `j`/`jp` in use, per-jurisdiction unplotted counts (tier 3 + no point), facet totals.
- **Coverage table real rule** (`declared-scope@1`): `D-K1-4 [B-22] = yes` applied verbatim — a source covers jurisdictions inside its declared `sources.toml` scope; crowdsourced/global sources (OSM/DeFlock — `publisher_type = "crowdsourced"` or no declared scope) are listed but never count as "looked"; single-source counts are shown, never suppressed. Replaces the soft `rule-pending@1` emission; dossier-figure children draw real `covered`/`not_covered` verdicts.
- Additive site-row columns (`first_seen`, `last_seen`, `operator_label`, `operator_key`, `vendor_label`, `vendor_key`, `point_uncertainty_m`, `lifecycle`) — nullable, never guessed; `pm` derives from the tier's declared uncertainty.
- `tile_verify` replays the same merge for conservation; `PYTHON_RENDERER_VERSION` → `sig.map-tiles/2+py.3`.
